围绕实验室布局重点方向进行课题征集，包括以下主题：A. 大模型与智能体安全建议研究方向包括但不限于：1. 大模型事实性、忠实性与幻觉评测、识别及削减2. 长上下文安全推理、风险证据保持与可信决策3. 安全知识增强的轻量模型与动态协同高效推理4. 智能体全链路风险建模、安全评估与闭环验证5. 智能体技能认证、工具调用安全、最小权限与供应链防护6. 模型微调、知识编辑、压缩及持续学习中的安全对齐保持、监测与退化修复B. 多模态智能及其安全建议研究方向包括但不限于：1. 多源异构数据的跨模态对齐、一致性度量与可信表征2. 多模态知识融合、协同推演与可解释深度推理3. 视觉语义诱导、跨模态指令干扰与智能体意图韧性4. 视觉—语言—动作模型的物理对抗攻击、迁移与动作安全5. 合成内容水印、可信标识、来源追溯与对抗规避检测6. 多模态生成模型的投毒、后门、对抗操纵及生成滥用防护C. 互联网信息服务算法风险演化与治理建议研究方向包括但不限于：1. 信息茧房、内容同质化与兴趣固化的度量及长期治理2. 推荐系统动态反馈环路、偏差放大机理与风险溯因3. 因果表示解耦、反事实评估与推荐效用约束下的自主干预4. 黑盒推荐对抗攻击、多尺度风险发现与可复现安全测试5. 异常用户和异常交互识别、鲁棒推荐学习与动态防御6. 时序数据质量检测、智能修复、风险演化建模与动态预警D. 社会认知与多智能体协同计算建议研究方向包括但不限于：1. 智能体记忆反思、自动归因、交互纠偏与逻辑一致性校验2. 人格动机、隐性意图、关系权力及社会规范的群体认知建模3. 基于知识论点的多智能体动态博弈、可信协商与共识评价4. 长程交互中的社会状态演化、记忆巩固与跨主体冲突恢复5. 社会心智评测数据自动生成、交互模拟与安全测评基准6. 社会化过程监督、双轨认知训练与风险自适应可靠推理E. 隐私计算与数据要素可信流通建议研究方向包括但不限于：1. 多类隐私攻击的耦合关系、风险放大效应与协同检测2. 差分隐私、联邦学习和访问控制的动态协同防护3. 高敏感模型记忆量化、敏感信息定位与隐私风险建模4. 选择性安全遗忘、遗忘完整性验证与可信知识更新5. 人工智能模型动态水印、知识产权保护与鲁棒权属验证6. 数据动态指纹、隐写标识、“一人一码”分发与抗共谋溯源F. 端侧智能系统安全建议研究方向包括但不限于：1. 大模型生成RTL代码的侧信道检测与硬件安全生成2. 低开销抗泄露加固、自适应攻击模拟与反馈优化3. 压缩模型表征退化分析、轻量化鲁棒恢复与安全增强4. 鲁棒性、时延、算力及功耗约束下的安全协同调度5. 边云协同分布式学习的投毒检测、可信贡献评估与鲁棒聚合6. 端侧运行时完整性验证、攻击隔离、安全降级与离线自主恢复申请要求1. 申请人需具有博士学位或副高级及以上技术职称，且须是非实验室固定研究人员。

In the fourth national assessment in 2018, it was awarded the title of Excellent National Key Laboratory. Guided by the policy of Openness, Mobility, Cooperation, Competition, SKLAFM has made significant achievements in multiple fields over the years, including attracting disciplinary talents, promoting scientific research development, constructing research platforms, and expanding academic exchanges.To promote domestic and international academic communication and cooperation, expand the role of SKLAFM as a center for academic exchange and scientific research, and elevate its research standards in related fields, the Open Research Project Fund is established in accordance with the “Measures for the Administration of Construction and Operation of State Key Laboratories”and the development plan of SKLAFM. Domestic and international researchers are cordially invited to apply for the Open Research Projects, and joint applications with SKLAFM researchers are strongly encouraged. The Academic Committee of SKLAFM will select open projects based on the principles of “fair competition, scientific peer review, and merit-based support.” The guidelines for 2027 annual open project are released as follows:I. Main research fields of the open projects supported by SKLAFM: 1) High-performance fibers and composite. Facing the critical national needs, we specialize in advancing large-scale industrial production technologies and developing innovative material systems for three key categories of high-performance fibers: High-performance carbon fibers(including T-series and MJ-series); Organic high-performance fibers (such as polyimide fibers, aramid fibers, liquid crystal polyarylester fibers, and ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fibers); Inorganic high-performance fibers (including ceramic fibers, basalt fibers, and alumina fibers). The research covers the entire value chain, from raw material preparation and spinning processes to composite applications in vital sectors like national defense, aerospace, transportation equipment, and extreme environment exploration.2)Functional fibers and green manufacturing. Facing the pressing needs of economic development, we focus on driving the high-value transformation and green upgrading of the traditional chemical fiber industry. The efforts center on developing non-petrochemical raw materials (such as recycled chemical fibers and bio-based feedstocks) alongside innovative process technologies (including green wet/dry spinning solvents, melt spinning and direct melt spinning, and intelligent production line design). Additionally, we optimize material functionalization (antibacterial, flame-retardant, and selective permeability properties, excluding energy conversion) and explore high-value-added applications in fields such as biomedical engineering and environmental purification.3)Intelligent fibers and cutting-edge applications. Facing the forefront of global technological innovation, we focus on developing next-generation intelligent fiber materials that will drive future industrial advancements. The research encompasses functional fibers for converting energy forms, including semiconductor fibers, energy storage and conversion fibers, catalytic fibers, and sensing fibers capable of transforming energy forms such as photoelectric and magnetic energy. Simultaneously, we explore novel fiber manufacturing technologies, including innovative monomers, catalysts, and additives, as well as advanced polymerization methods and AI-driven material design paradigms. II. We encourage technicians whose research interests are relevant to SKLAFM and who are able to advance the development of SKLAFM to submit applications for this funding.
